    H=len(grid); W=len(grid[0]); out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    colors=sorted({v for row in grid for v in row if v})
    objs=[]
    for c in colors:

    objs.sort(key=lambda z:min(x for r,row in enumerate(grid) for x,v in enumerate(row) if v==z[0]))

    occupied=set()

'''
